consent.title: Your Privacy Matters
consent.summary: We explain your medical reports in simple terms. Here is how your data is handled safely:
consent.point1: We use your report only to generate your simple explanation and spoken audio.
consent.point2: Your personal identifiers (name, phone, address, lab ID) are removed before processing.
consent.point3: Your data is kept safe and automatically deleted after 30 days. You can also delete everything at any time in Settings.
consent.point4: ReportSaathi is an educational aid, not a doctor. Always consult a qualified medical professional for health decisions.
consent.declined: Consent is required to process lab reports.
